result.stdout:
Archneter CLI

USAGE:
  archneter <command> [options]

COMMANDS:
  help                                                                                                                                            Display available commands
  archneter inspect [type] [target] [options]                                                                                                     Inspects the project architecture and dependencies.
  new <ProjectName> --arch <type> [--services <S1,S2,...>] [--modules <M1,M2,...>] [--features <F1,F2,...>] [--tests <true|false>] [--dry-run]    Scaffold a new architecture solution
  refactor --to <architecture> [--dir <path>] [--dry-run] [--skip-backup] [--force]                                                               Analyze and refactor an existing .NET project into a target architecture
  ui                                                                                                                                              Launch the Archneter Web Dashboard

OPTIONS:
  For 'inspect':
    --used-by                   Shows all classes that depend on the specified target.

    --details                   Shows detailed dependency information for a specific class.

    --circular                  Detects circular dependencies in the project.

    --unused                    Finds registered DI services that are never injected.

    --graph                     Generates an SVG/HTML dependency graph.

    --di                        Analyzes Dependency Injection registrations for errors.

    --stats                     Displays architecture statistics.

  For 'new':
    --arch <type>               Architecture template to generate
        clean            → Clean Architecture (default)
        microservices    → Microservices
        n-tier           → N-Tier (PL → BLL → DAL)
        verticalslice    → Vertical Slice
        modularmonolith  → Modular Monolith

    --services <names>          Comma-separated service names (microservices only)
        e.g. Order,Product,Id
[truncated]
